title: Automation Is Not a Robot. It's a List of Steps.
description: Before you buy an AI tool, write down the steps you already do. Mark which repeat, automate one at a time, and keep approvals with a person.
ogDescription: Write the steps first. Rule, pattern and copy steps can be automated. Judgment stays with you.
alt: Six step list for an estimate request marked rule, pattern, copy and judgment
ctaLine: Write the step list before you buy a tool.

rows.action: Approve and send stay with a person

author: Nick
